text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, just one of my favorite hand creams.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's not particularly popular, but I haven't been able to get another since it went out of stock last week.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I recommended the same product to a darling pony last week. I wonder if she managed to buy one.
choice_data_list: Maybe it's sold out because you recommended it to her.

text_block_list.text: But indeed, that was why. All of Fuji Kiseki's fans rushed to buy the same hand cream, leaving her hands dry and flaky for a while.
